scope: Research-only extension of fixed V15 and Road5→Road6 true B51-13→14; no new concept adopted or official source/receiver semantic change.

physicalContext.significance: Prior R50-R52 were blocked by putting a LOWER receiver behind/under protected forebay19. R53 tested the structurally different causal orientation of an elevated quarry-fed waterfall pouring into EXISTING protected19 instead; this also changes source/receiver interpretation and is not approved as canon.

method.reference: R41 approximate 505x350 software z-buffer on genuine R44 Blender triangle geometry and the 3 true original R38 camera matrices.
method.originalSourceRawScreens: Previous genuine R49 OFF original screenshots reused for illustrative overlays only
method.caveats: R53 proposal was NOT rendered in Chromium WebGL2, NOT authored as Blender, NOT water dynamics. Depth approximation ignores alpha, fog, culling and near-plane clipping; simple colored quads are NOT real ART.

testedSections.name: A upper quarry high source and drop
testedSections.criticalRead: Elevated reservoir surface does not read at original chase camera (camera below upper water and hidden by test silhouette); orange vertical slab is visible but the reason for the facility and relation to existing water are not legible.

testedSections.name: B lower and camera-viewable quarry-fed source
testedSections.criticalRead: Dropping upper source below camera makes a 21-27 half-resolution pixel top surface numerically visible, but the screenshot shows a narrow top line, large rectangular vertical panel and isolated support. It does not communicate a recognizable upstream waterbody or water falling into existing protected forebay19.

visualGrounding.R53QualitativeVeto: Even the alternative source-high/receiver-protected water topology looks like generic orange wall and yellow slab; near-source water is a line and impact splash/loading/hydraulic linkage are unproven.

decision.whyNotBlenderOrCI: One decisive visual semantic veto suffices. More triangles, color/pixel tuning or new CI on unapproved source reinterpretation would repeat R48-R52's nonproductive effort.
decision.scope: One distinct topology with two height feasibility checks, three source camera frames. This does not prove ALL source-safe designs impossible.
decision.nextMeaningfulGate: STOP analogous small quads/position sweeps. Before authoring another hydraulic candidate, establish a different full-frame physically supported and unmistakable source→working machine→vertical drop→receiver temporal sequence IN ORIGINAL SOURCE CAMERA. If source19 must remain upstream, do not silently turn it into receiver. Consider seeking separate explicit authorization ONLY IF evidence supports a targeted protected-source design change; otherwise avoid speculative source changes. Maintain V15 gate order; B51 true failure→retry→avoid is still unqualified.
